records.name: Biopsy (simple)
records.text: A biopsy collects cells or tissue for examination. Its findings describe the sampled material and collection time.

records.name: Tumour-bed biopsy after neoadjuvant therapy (simple)
records.text: A biopsy after drug treatment samples parts of the former breast tumour bed. A negative sample can miss remaining cancer and does not by itself establish that surgery can be omitted.

records.name: Margins after breast-conserving surgery, and second operations (simple)
Capecitabine (simple)
records.text: The body converts capecitabine tablets into fluorouracil. Taking a medicine by mouth does not remove the risk of serious harm.

records.name: Core needle biopsy and fine-needle aspiration (FNA) (simple)
records.text: A core needle takes small cylinders of tissue; a fine needle collects cells or fluid. Each samples a site, so a useful result depends on the question and the material collected.

records.name: Grade, stage and receptor status: three different things on one breast report (simple)
HER2-low and HER2-ultralow (simple)
records.text: Tumours with just a little HER2, which older HER2 drugs ignored but Enhertu can attack.

records.name: HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified) (simple)
records.text: HER2-positive breast cancer has an integrated result showing excess HER2 protein or gene amplification under the testing rules. Whether a particular medicine is suitable is a separate question.

records.name: Invasive breast carcinoma of no special type (invasive ductal carcinoma) (simple)
Olaparib (simple)
records.text: The first PARP pill. It turned an inherited BRCA fault into a drug target.

records.name: PD-L1 CPS (combined positive score) (simple)
records.text: CPS compares certain PD-L1-stained tumour and immune cells with viable tumour cells. Its reported score stops at 100, and its use depends on the assay and treatment setting.

records.name: Surgical resection specimen (simple)
records.text: Removed tissue is mapped into selected blocks for examination. Its report describes the examined material, rather than every cell in the tumour or body.

records.name: Tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) (simple)
records.text: Tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes are lymphocytes in tumour tissue. Location, cell identity, the measurement denominator and useful function are separate questions.
